cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your coffee. I know this machine. Cup under the outlet, please; this button starts the cycle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. Coffee's behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Open the flap before selecting coffee, not after. Put your cup back under the outlet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It makes two cups unless you turn that dial. I only want one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then dial to one. We set the portion before starting, please. I can't personalise the service if you keep moving ahead of the procedure.
